# telnyx_inbound_voice_channel_settings (Data Source)

The number of inbound voice channels of the account in the US zone. There is one per account; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Number) The current number of concurrent channels set for the account
- `id` (String) Always inbound_voice_channel_settings: there is one per account.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the response
